name: Depth of a Category Tree
desc:
A product category tree is a binary tree of TreeNode objects (val, left, right). Implement max_depth(root): the number of nodes on the longest path from the root down to a leaf, or 0 if root is None.

The class TreeNode is already defined. In the tests, the tree is shown in level order, with null for a missing child (like on most coding platforms).

Example

For tree = [3, 9, 20, null, null, 15, 7], the output should be

3
[execution time limit] 4 seconds (py3)
[memory limit] 1 GB
[input] array.integer tree
[output] integer
